filePkgPathUrl.description:
The file package path url in the server of the file for which encountered the
AST-generation error.

errorMessage.description: The error message encountered during AST generation.

line.description: The line on which the AST generation issue occurred.

column.description: The column in the {@link #line} on which the AST generation issue occurred.

filename.description: The name of the file for which the diff is being parsed in the source control repository.

filePathInSourceControlRepo.description: The path of the file for which the diff is being parsed in the source control repository.

encodedAnchor.description:
The encoded anchor to the line that's causing this AST generation error.

For instance, for GitHub, an anchor to line 15 for the `TestType.js` file in the `c3repo`
folder would look as follows:
`https://github.com/c3-e/c3repo/blob/<commitSha>/<path/to>/TestType.js#L15`

isChanged.description: Boolean to indicate whether the file that raised this AST generation error was changed.

title: Type to store the result of an unsuccessful attempt to generate an AST for a file.
name: BaseCodeAnalysis.Ast.Error.Processed
